reviews.title: Sketchy Ads
reviews.text: This app does what I need it to do. The only downside is there are a lot of ads, and some of them are sketchy. One says my phone has a virus and IOS is damaged by 72%. And further damage would result in locking up and loss of all data, instructing me to click the button to remove all viruses. Another says we have detected that your device has been hacked after visiting adult websites. It also instructs me to click a button, be redirected to the “App Store”, and download this undisclosed clean up program. I have recently had my computer remotely accessed after trying to download Claude from the App Store. Turns out, it wasn’t Anthropic’s. Fortunately all I lost was my computer data, but it very easily could have been everything ranging feom email access, bank accounts, and all website/platform access. Because you allow for these bad actors to have a space to feed, I give you one star.
